name: Jehohanan
overview: The name Jehohanan appears in Scripture associated with several roles reflecting faithful service to God’s covenant community. He is identified as a son of Bebai among the returned exiles, affirming his priestly lineage (Ezra 10:28). Jehohanan also served as a chorister in the temple, contributing to the worship ministry under the oversight of Jezrahiah (Nehemiah 12:42). Additionally, he is mentioned in a leadership capacity connected to Ezra and Amariah, indicating involvement in temple governance or service (Nehemiah 12:13). These references collectively highlight Jehohanan’s dedication to both the spiritual and communal restoration of Israel after the Babylonian exile.
